name: @equin/plugin-infra-git-tree-lock
description: A checkout's working tree as a reader/writer lock: holdTreeRead(root) while a process loads code from the tree (shared, in-process fast path), withTreeWrite(root, write) around a git command that rewrites it (push's fast-forward of main) — so a booting process sees the tree wholly before or wholly after a fast-forward, never a mix of the two commits.
